global_prerequisites_note: Composition is conditional: named substances, articles, radioactive materials and wastes may use different paths. Candidate evidence fields are alternatives, never globally AND.

final_state_contract.conservative_project_gate: All relevant hazard pathways resolved with cited evidence AND named-entry/SP/edition checks AND independent review. This is an engineering safety constraint, not an ADR citation.
